groundTruth.rootCause: The payment service fails 10% of charge requests, so checkout cannot place orders.

hypothesis: The checkout errors start in the payment service. Some of payment's Charge calls are rejected with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.', in at least one case for a gold-loyalty user, and checkout passes those failures on. This is a partial failure, not an outage: about 1 failed checkout per minute out of roughly 0.45–0.8 requests per second (about 2–3%), and payment logged 25 successful transactions in the same window. In the OpenTelemetry Demo, this error matches the paymentFailure feature flag being on at a low percentage, but I haven't confirmed the flag state from flagd.
